set.body: Portable I/O and AOI integration milestone. Exit: CSV ingest and result exports; checked Session and AOI sequence/transition operations; a redistributable real EDF-derived ASC reaches a scanpath and preserves experimenter messages; line/sample/event accounting and explicit unknown/rejected records; synchronization and AOI accounting laws. v-asc-e2e is the real ASC gate. The licensed dual-oracle EyeLink reliability epic remains a separate programme and does not block this milestone or pure plan/codec development. Do not imply vendor certification from a portable fixture.
